title: Google DeepMind Leadership Changes
raw_excerpt: Demis Hassabis moved to the role of chair of Google DeepMind and chief scientist of Alphabet, while Jeff Dean departed after 27 years to launch Discovery Loop. Alphabet shares fell more than 5% following the announcement.
summary: 谷歌AI组织迎来重大调整：DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis转任董事长兼Alphabet首席科学家，而谷歌元老Jeff Dean在任职27年后离职，创立AI4S公司Discovery Loop，旨在自动化科研实验循环。消息公布后Alphabet股价下跌约5%。这一变动标志着谷歌AI领导层的新旧交替，也反映出其在AI竞赛中的压力与转型决心。

title: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT free users unlimited text chats

Right now, you may run into rate limits if you do too many text chats on those tiers, but those limits, just for text, will be going away soon. Messages that include things like file uploads and images will continue to have limits. Next week, OpenAI is also adding a "Think" button for free and Go users that they can use to "access higher reasoning for harder questions." title: Meta Releases Muse Code
raw_excerpt: Meta Muse Code is a terminal coding agent powered by Muse Spark 1.2 that can handle complex repository-level engineering tasks.
summary: Meta发布Muse Code，一款由Muse Spark 1.2驱动的终端编码代理，能够处理复杂的仓库级工程任务。Muse Code的推出标志着Meta在AI编程助手领域的进一步布局，其强大的仓库级理解能力有望提升开发者的编码效率，并推动AI辅助编程向更复杂场景发展。

title: WeatherNext: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
summary: Google DeepMind发布WeatherNext，一款在气旋预报上取得突破的AI模型。该模型利用深度学习技术，显著提升了热带气旋路径和强度的预测精度，有望在防灾减灾中发挥关键作用。WeatherNext的成功展示了AI在科学计算领域的巨大潜力，为气象预报带来了新的可能性。

title: Anthropic hiring an AI Chip Design Team
raw_excerpt: Anthropic confirmed plans to co-design custom silicon and AI models to improve Claude's speed and efficiency. The company began hiring chip engineers as it sought additional infrastructure beyond its existing hardware partnerships.

title: cloudflare/computer
summary: Cloudflare开源“computer”项目，旨在为AI代理提供虚拟计算机环境，使其能够执行更复杂的任务。该项目在GitHub上迅速获得2800+星标，反映了开发者对代理基础设施的强烈需求。通过提供安全的沙箱环境，Cloudflare有望推动AI代理在自动化、测试等领域的应用。

title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer
raw_excerpt:
作者: Xinye Wang, Junxiao Liu, Shujian Huang
摘要: Multilingual reasoning transfer is crucial for extending reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) beyond high-resource languages. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) and its variants have emerged as a promising paradigm, providing dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts, yet their objectives do not explicitly prioritize reasoning signals most critical to cross-lingual transfer. We characterize that target-language reasoning comprises the generation of both surface text and reasoning pivots, which are decisions that advance or redirect the reasoning process and shape subsequent inference. This motivates concentrating privileged distillation around such pivots. We therefore propose RP-OPSD, Reasoning-Pivot-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation, using the distributional shift between matched teacher views with and without an English reference solution as an operational proxy to guide privileged distillation and reference anchoring. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks covering 17 languages and multiple difficulty levels show that our method outperforms strong multilingual reasoning baselines and OPSD variants. Further analysis reveals that RP-OPSD concentrates privileged distillation on reasoning-control and problem-condistioned state-update tokens, while downweighting it for tokens that mainly support surface realization. Our code is available at https://github.com/NJUNLP/RP-OPSD.
summary: 论文提出RP-OPSD，一种基于推理枢轴引导的on-policy自蒸馏方法，用于多语言推理迁移。该方法通过显式优先处理跨语言迁移中关键的推理信号，提升了低资源语言的推理能力。实验表明，RP-OPSD在多个多语言基准上优于现有方法，为多语言模型训练提供了新思路。

title: Show me《指环王》！卡帕西强推大模型评测新基准
raw_excerpt: 指环王成为大模型新基准
summary: 卡帕西（Karpathy）推荐了一个新的评测基准，以《指环王》为测试内容，评估大模型在复杂叙事理解、知识检索和生成方面的能力。该基准通过电影和书籍的跨模态问题，挑战模型的深层语义理解，为AI评测提供了更具挑战性和趣味性的新标准。
